blocks.why: Per-image scale rows are not in this clone. family_prior is still a usable label. sx, sy were not fit to expert outputs.

host_faithful.measure agreed on one synthetic INTER_AREA resize when sx and sy differed. 10 MultExp call sites still pass the same px_per_mm for both axes. 2 infer call sites pass sx, sy separately. Forcing sy = sx on a (1, 1) pixel step moves the physical angle by 18.43 degrees. That call-site split is not closed.

MT uses centreline separation minus half thickness. PA uses slope_deg of the apo_curves centreline polynomial, not the rich inner-edge tangent. No GT-apo comparison was run; images are not in this clone.
The production aggregator is a weighted median of SVD segments. Vesselness, Hough, and local projection/LOESS were not compared on held-out images.

The coupling identity is implemented as a diagnostic only. At L=50 mm and 15 degrees, a +1 degree pennation error predicts -3.2568 mm of FL change with thickness fixed. No per-image signed residuals exist here, so the identity has not explained the FL error. line_curve_intersection does not reject near-parallel crossings.

The frozen affine is ordinary least squares (np.polyfit), not a regularized absolute-deviation fit. The affine JSON marks FL as applied while infer_rl_refiner leaves FL raw. No new coefficients were fit.
infer_rl_refiner still rewrites non-.tif ids, and the submitted CSV is absent. Eval and deploy are not one function.
